sources.shape: Lally et al. (2025) deposited configuration: semi-major axis 0.030994811518716577 au over their 0.752 solar-radius star = 8.863 stellar radii; inclination 85.71 degrees (Table 1, from Agol et al. 2010); eccentricity 0
sources.phase: Lally et al. (2025) deposited configuration: t0 59838.6863112, the transit time their map was fitted with. Table 1 labels it UTC; it is used here on the TDB scale of the scene, 69 s later, 0.04 percent of an orbit.
sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north), as in the configuration (Omega 0).
